title: 차수피벗 업체 분배수량 변경 계약

displayExportPolicy.weekTitle: white foreground on all fixed/unfixed/partial/empty dark header backgrounds, overriding global table header color
displayExportPolicy.notes: existing outDescr/descrMap is display-only; pvDescrOpen top checkbox toggles inline customer-cell notes and summary notes without writes; summary includes customer label and wrapping; zero-quantity response rows with existing notes are retained
displayExportPolicy.excel: each week has a quantity-change text column built from same descrMap and customer labels regardless of UI note visibility; numeric quantities and SUM formula cells preserved; no formulas for text note columns; no extra history query
displayExportPolicy.preserve: all ERP writes, year scopes, quantity and stock arithmetic unchanged

pasteIncomingDisplayPolicy.operation: SELECT-only WarehouseMaster + WarehouseDetail current OrderYear + OrderWeek + ProdKey lookup; no ERP write is permitted
pasteIncomingDisplayPolicy.crossYear: A same-OrderWeek prior-year WarehouseMaster is excluded by the explicit selected OrderYear predicate.

policyBoundaries: This contract covers week-pivot, adjust, paste-order distribution, and explicit farm-distribution only.
The separate estimate-additional-product contract intentionally continues to require a FarmKey; this optional-farm rule does not relax that workflow.

farmAssignmentPolicy.omitted: preserve ShipmentFarm including zero rows; farm assignment is optional for both a new ShipmentDetail and an existing ShipmentDetail with no ShipmentFarm rows
farmAssignmentPolicy.explicit: replace with submitted valid candidates; assignment total must equal the post-change ShipmentDetail.OutQuantity
farmAssignmentPolicy.reason: FormShipmentDistribution.btnSave_Click saves ShipmentDetail first and inserts ShipmentFarm only for modified farm-grid rows whose FarmKey is valid. It does not reject an empty or FarmKey=0 farm grid.

actions.name: ADD_WITHOUT_ACTIVE_ORDER
actions.stockOverride: never automatic; explicit user confirmation only

pasteMixedBatchPolicy.executionOrder: the UI sends one stable CANCEL phase followed by one stable ADD phase in a single atomic request
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.selectionModel: actions come from the pasted analysis; users do not build a separate multi-selection
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.atomicApi: POST /api/shipment/adjust-batch with explicit year, week, and ordered entries
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.cancelApiPolicy: the atomic API reuses the existing type=CANCEL and mode=AUTO_CANCEL policy
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.addApiPolicy: the atomic API reuses the existing type=ADD combined order+shipment policy
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.failurePolicy: all-or-nothing; any entry failure rolls back every CANCEL and ADD entry, the UI reports success 0 and all rows rolled back, and the user reruns the full batch after correcting the cause
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.clientPreflightPolicy: every non-skipped pasted row must have a confirmed CustKey, ProdKey, and positive quantity before the first write; an unmatched ADD may never be omitted while matched CANCEL rows are submitted
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.forcePolicy: force is always false for the global paste batch and cannot be enabled by an entry payload
pasteMixedBatchPolicy.uiRefreshPolicy: registered order state, shipment quantity state, and order history refresh only after success=true for the whole atomic batch

sideEffects.shipmentDetail: decrease when active shipment exists; otherwise fail the whole atomic batch

sideEffects.shipmentDateAndFarm: reuse existing adjust synchronization; farm assignment remains optional when omitted

pasteMixedBatchPolicy.undoPolicy: the last successful in-memory batch can be undone once; undo acquires a fresh edit lease for every customer and sends its editGuard; original ADD restores order+shipment and original CANCEL restores shipment only; every row must pass post-write verification inside one transaction; changed current quantities abort and roll back the whole undo; the client refreshes its baseline and releases all leases before enabling the action button again; a client timeout is reported as unknown until a fresh read, never assumed rolled back

postWriteVerificationPolicy.successMeaning: success is returned only after the same transaction re-reads raw Order/Shipment rows, ViewOrder/ViewShipment, and ShipmentDate totals
postWriteVerificationPolicy.orderOnlyRegistration: POST /api/orders must re-read raw OrderDetail and ViewOrder for every changed product before commit
postWriteVerificationPolicy.distributionRegistration: POST /api/shipment/adjust and adjust-batch must re-read raw OrderDetail, raw ShipmentDetail, ViewOrder, ViewShipment, and ShipmentDate before commit
postWriteVerificationPolicy.mismatchPolicy: any missing, duplicate, hidden, customer-mismatched, or quantity-mismatched row throws inside the transaction and rolls back the entire request
postWriteVerificationPolicy.uiPolicy: paste UI may display completion and learn mappings only when success=true and verified=true
postWriteVerificationPolicy.auditPolicy: SHIPMENT_ADJUST_BATCH logs committedCount and verifiedCount instead of reporting a successful zero-impact action

pastePageInitializationPolicy.pageOpen: paste, base-stock, and remaining-stock input fields start empty; a saved stock note may be checked for existence but is never applied automatically
pastePageInitializationPolicy.baseWeekChange: changing the selected base week checks saved-note availability only and preserves the current input fields
pastePageInitializationPolicy.explicitLoad: a saved note is applied to the input fields only after the user clicks the load button
pastePageInitializationPolicy.mappingCache: learned product and customer mappings are preserved because they are matching history, not pasted order input
pastePageInitializationPolicy.erpSideEffects: page open, base-week change, and explicit load are UI-only and must not write Order, Shipment, Stock, Estimate, or WebProfitReport tables

pasteUnitPolicy.explicitInput: 원문에 박스/단/송이/송이(대)/스템/스팀 단위가 명시되면 Product.OutUnit, 과거 주문이력, 저장 단위 학습보다 항상 우선한다.
pasteUnitPolicy.spacingAndAliases: 송 이, 송이 ( 대 ), 스 템 ( 대 ), stem/stems/steam 표기는 모두 송이로 정규화하며 박스로 fallback하지 않는다.
pasteUnitPolicy.omittedInput: 단위가 생략된 경우에만 품목 OutUnit과 기존 주문이력 기본단위를 사용한다.
pasteUnitPolicy.conversion: 명시 송이는 OrderDetail.SteamQuantity에 입력하고 Product.OutUnit 환산값은 기존 FormOrderAdd 호환 경로로 계산한다.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025와 2026에 같은 OrderWeek·CustKey·ProdKey가 있을 때 2026 요청은 2026 행만 읽고 쓴다. stock-status view=pivot도 OrderMaster를 선택 연도로 제한하고 ShipmentMaster를 OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey로 결합한다.
